name: Missoni
why: Knitwear in multicolored zigzag and space-dyed patterns.
origin: Founded in 1953 by Ottavio and Rosita Missoni.

onething.n: direct — cotton piqué with the zigzag motif; not a knit, renamed accordingly

notes.ital: The zigzag is a knitting technique, not a print — worked out at Sumirago by a family that came to fashion from athletics. Color as the house's entire vocabulary.

notes.craft: Missoni makes all its ready-to-wear knit fabric itself, at Sumirago (Varese) and at Tricotex, a former supplier it bought in 2024; the sewing is shared between its own seamstresses and many local workshops, and wovens/denim are not shown to be in-house. Every sampled product page says Made in Italy but names no maker or mill, and missoni.com does not itself describe the factory. Owned making of the signature category, not the whole range: a 4.

cities: 4 stores — Aventura, Las Vegas, Miami, New York · department stores, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: Knit-fabric making owned, garment making only partly. Press visit (FashionNetwork Italia, 31 Jul 2025): 'Tutti i tessuti a maglia per il prêt-à-porter della maison vengono realizzati qui' (the Sumirago, Varese site, with historic Caperdoni knitting machines) 'e nel vicino stabilimento dell'ex fornitore Tricotex, acquisito all'inizio del 2024'; at Sumirago 'alcuni pezzi speciali vengono tagliati a mano e poi assemblati dalle sarte', and the house also relies on 'numerosi laboratori locali'. Tricotex (Raschel knit fabrics) acquisition March 2024 confirmed by the-spin-off.com and WWD headlines; Missoni statement: 'maintain direct control over its value chain'. Sumirago factory built 1969 (Wikipedia). These are Missoni's own (Missoni S.p.A.), not a parent group's; owners since May 2026: FSI ~73%, Katjes International ~27% (missoni.com press release). Nothing found on missoni.com itself describing the factory.
